protocol.timingBoundary: First source-chunk request through final CPU-readable PCM; excludes initialization, validation, hashing, WAV encoding and save. Optional articleCallPeakRssBytes spans the entire browser call including post-timer validation/export. Generation RSS uses timestamped samples inside browser generation start/end boundaries; it includes the owned Chrome process tree and browser baseline.

environment.machineLabel: MacBook Pro / Apple M1 Pro 8-core / 16 GiB / arm64

support.scope: Named base speakers in the upstream checkpoint catalog. The benchmark adapter exposes one fixed English voice.
support.notes: US_James is the sole benchmarked voice. The count deduplicates named base voices and excludes emotion variants, voice cloning and voice design.

cells.precision: Q8_0 GGUF; the pinned checkpoint retains a BF16 stop head and F32 speaker encoder.

settings.modelCache: Pinned GGUF stored in 16 MiB same-origin CacheStorage ranges keyed by full asset SHA-256, then filled into Emscripten MEMFS; incomplete ranges are rejected. Cache entries can be evicted and fetched again.
settings.output: Mono 44.1 kHz Float32 PCM; offline API returns the complete span before first-pcm is emitted.

capability.description: Observed 1540847 WebGPU dispatches during untimed synthesis with finite CPU-readable PCM. Hooks were installed before runtime init and the probe is outside generation timing.

notes: Capability checks run separately before timing. GPU dispatch does not imply GPU-exclusive execution.
Raw WAV is saved locally; opt-in audio publication is separate from timing and automatic result submission.
English 20k November campaign. Sequential headed Chrome, AC power and one isolated benchmark tab. Predeclared backend order, no cold-load check. Separate generation-window RSS diagnostic.

RSS is sampled every 500 ms across the owned Chrome process tree, including the Chrome baseline and inference workers. Whole-call peak spans post-timer validation/export; generation mean uses only in-window samples from browser generation start through final CPU-readable PCM.
